title: 隧道分部開挖與支撐
summary: 分部開挖讓土岩的卸載、變形與支護成形交錯發生，最終斷面強度不能單獨說明施工期表現。本課以簡化反力曲線建立概念，再逐項檢視開挖面分割、早齡材料、仰拱閉合、收斂與防水介面。學員需用量測檢查每一個模型的邊界，將適配曲線、工程判斷及正式核准清楚區分。
summaryEn: Sequential excavation interleaves unloading, ground movement and support formation, so final-section strength alone cannot explain construction-stage behavior. The course begins with simplified reaction curves and then examines face subdivision, young materials, invert closure, convergence and waterproofing interfaces. Learners test each model boundary against observations and distinguish curve fitting, engineering judgment and formal authorization.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下原創算例針對分部開挖的地層支護互制、早齡襯砌與觀測回饋，每個輸入都是教學假設而非地標實測資料。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u以mm計，pg=0.6-0.02u MPa、ps=0.01(u-10) MPa且u≥10；相等得u=23.33 mm、p=0.133 MPa，僅為線性示例。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總斷面80 m²分為30、30、20 m²三部分，最大單部面積30/80=37.5%；每次假設進尺1 m時，最大單部原位開挖30 m³。兩式只回答各自所列的量與邊界，不應把單一平均結果當成整體穩定證明。請另以最不利的幾何、時間或接觸條件代入，分別標示量測誤差和模型偏差；交接記錄須保留原單位、資料日期以及未能確認的條件。
workedExample.textEn: This original worked example examines ground-support interaction, early-age lining and observational feedback in sequential excavation. Every input is a teaching assumption, not a measured value from a landmark. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume displacement u in mm, pg=0.6-0.02u MPa and ps=0.01(u-10) MPa for u≥10. Equating them gives u=23.33 mm and p=0.133 MPa, a linear illustration only. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume an 80 m² section divided into 30, 30 and 20 m² parts. The largest part is 30/80=37.5%; at an assumed 1 m increment its in-situ excavation is 30 m³. Each relation answers only its stated quantity under its stated boundary conditions. A favorable mean value is not proof of overall stability. Recalculate with an adverse geometry, timing or contact condition, distinguishing measurement uncertainty from model error. The handover record must retain original units, observation dates and conditions that remain unverified; the responsible designer decides whether additional evidence is needed.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地層支護曲線交點」與「分部面積與暴露尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ground-support curve intersection" and "Subdivided area and exposure scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地層支護曲線交點：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ground-support curve intersection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地層支護曲線交點」如何影響隧道分部開挖與支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ground-support curve intersection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sequential excavation and support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地層釋放變形時需求反力可能下降，已成形支護隨變形提供更多反力；交點代表特定簡化假設下的相容狀態。支護啟用前的位移會改變交點，兩條線並不是天然固定的材料常數。 假設u以mm計，pg=0.6-0.02u MPa、ps=0.01(u-10) MPa且u≥10；相等得u=23.33 mm、p=0.133 MPa，僅為線性示例。 把未觀測的先期變形設為零，會高估支護參與程度並錯估交點；即使後續曲線看似吻合，起始條件錯誤仍可能造成對施工變更的錯誤預測。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地層支護曲線交點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ground reaction demand may decrease as displacement develops, while installed support mobilizes increasing resistance. Their intersection is a compatible state under specified simplifying assumptions. Displacement before installation changes that state; neither line is a universal material constant. Assume displacement u in mm, pg=0.6-0.02u MPa and ps=0.01(u-10) MPa for u≥10. Equating them gives u=23.33 mm and p=0.133 MPa, a linear illustration only. Setting unobserved pre-installation movement to zero can overstate support participation and misplace the intersection. A visually good later fit does not remove that initial-condition error or make predictions of a changed sequence reliable. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ground-support curve intersection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地層與支護曲線一旦相交便證明所有失效均已排除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An intersection of ground and support curves proves every possible failure mode has been excluded." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地層支護曲線交點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ground-support curve intersection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：地層與支護曲線一旦相交便證明所有失效均已排除。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An intersection of ground and support curves proves every possible failure mode has been excluded. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地層支護曲線交點」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ground-support curve intersection" is correct?
options: 地層與支護曲線一旦相交便證明所有失效均已排除。
地層釋放變形時需求反力可能下降，已成形支護隨變形提供更多反力；交點代表特定簡化假設下的相容狀態。
把斷面分成三塊就能把所有荷載與風險降為三分之一。
optionsEn: An intersection of ground and support curves proves every possible failure mode has been excluded.
Ground reaction demand may decrease as displacement develops, while installed support mobilizes increasing resistance.
Dividing a section into three parts reduces every load and risk to one third.
quiz.explanation: 地層釋放變形時需求反力可能下降，已成形支護隨變形提供更多反力；交點代表特定簡化假設下的相容狀態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ground reaction demand may decrease as displacement develops, while installed support mobilizes increasing resistance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地層支護曲線交點：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ground-support curve intersection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地層支護曲線交點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ground-support curve intersection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u以mm計，pg=0.6-0.02u MPa、ps=0.01(u-10) MPa且u≥10；相等得u=23.33 mm、p=0.133 MPa，僅為線性示例。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume displacement u in mm, pg=0.6-0.02u MPa and ps=0.01(u-10) MPa for u≥10. Equating them gives u=23.33 mm and p=0.133 MPa, a linear illustration only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將收斂與支護應變資料配對，檢查啟用時間、初始位移和力換算的可辨識性；比較多個初始位移假設的交點，若量測不能區分它們，須保留解的範圍，不把一個最佳擬合當成唯一真實地層。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair convergence and support-strain histories, checking installation time, initial movement and force conversion.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「地層支護曲線交點」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ground-support curve intersection", which statement holds?
options: 平均應力是壓縮就表示襯砌每個位置都沒有拉裂。
量到的所有應變乘最終彈性模數就是當下內力。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。

All measured strain multiplied by the final elastic modulus gives the current internal force.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.

steps.title: 地層支護曲線交點：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ground-support curve intersection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地層支護曲線交點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ground-support curve intersection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將收斂與支護應變資料配對，檢查啟用時間、初始位移和力換算的可辨識性；比較多個初始位移假設的交點，若量測不能區分它們，須保留解的範圍，不把一個最佳擬合當成唯一真實地層。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair convergence and support-strain histories, checking installation time, initial movement and force conversion. Compare intersections for alternative initial displacements. If observations cannot distinguish them, retain a range of solutions rather than treating a best fit as the uniquely correct ground response. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每次比較先列出啟用位移、材料齡期與三維效應的處理方式，將模型結果交設計者連同失效模式審查，不能以曲線交點自行批准下一步開挖。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before each comparison, list installation displacement, material age and treatment of three-dimensional effects. The designer reviews the model together with failure modes; an intersection alone cannot authorize the next excavation stage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把未觀測的先期變形設為零，會高估支護參與程度並錯估交點；即使後續曲線看似吻合，起始條件錯誤仍可能造成對施工變更的錯誤預測。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Setting unobserved pre-installation movement to zero can overstate support participation and misplace the intersection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將收斂與支護應變資料配對，檢查啟用時間、初始位移和力換算的可辨識性；比較多個初始位移假設的交點，若量測不能區分它們，須保留解的範圍，不把一個最佳擬合當成唯一真實地層。
knowledge.textEn: Pair convergence and support-strain histories, checking installation time, initial movement and force conversion. Compare intersections for alternative initial displacements. If observations cannot distinguish them, retain a range of solutions rather than treating a best fit as the uniquely correct ground response.

knowledge.text: 每次比較先列出啟用位移、材料齡期與三維效應的處理方式，將模型結果交設計者連同失效模式審查，不能以曲線交點自行批准下一步開挖。
knowledge.textEn: Before each comparison, list installation displacement, material age and treatment of three-dimensional effects. The designer reviews the model together with failure modes; an intersection alone cannot authorize the next excavation stage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地層支護曲線交點」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ground-support curve intersection"?
options: 將收斂與支護應變資料配對，檢查啟用時間、初始位移和力換算的可辨識性。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
內表面沒有滴水就表示外側水壓可以忽略。
optionsEn: Pair convergence and support-strain histories, checking installation time, initial movement and force conversion.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A dry inner surface means that external water pressure can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 將收斂與支護應變資料配對，檢查啟用時間、初始位移和力換算的可辨識性；比較多個初始位移假設的交點，若量測不能區分它們，須保留解的範圍，不把一個最佳擬合當成唯一真實地層。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair convergence and support-strain histories, checking installation time, initial movement and force conversion. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地層支護曲線交點：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ground-support curve intersection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地層支護曲線交點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ground-support curve intersection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把未觀測的先期變形設為零，會高估支護參與程度並錯估交點；即使後續曲線看似吻合，起始條件錯誤仍可能造成對施工變更的錯誤預測。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Setting unobserved pre-installation movement to zero can overstate support participation and misplace the intersection. A visually good later fit does not remove that initial-condition error or make predictions of a changed sequence reliable. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把未觀測的先期變形設為零，會高估支護參與程度並錯估交點；即使後續曲線看似吻合，起始條件錯誤仍可能造成對施工變更的錯誤預測。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地層與支護曲線一旦相交便證明所有失效均已排除。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An intersection of ground and support curves proves every possible failure mode has been excluded." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地層支護曲線交點」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

把未觀測的先期變形設為零，會高估支護參與程度並錯估交點；即使後續曲線看似吻合，起始條件錯誤仍可能造成對施工變更的錯誤預測。
把斷面分成三塊就能把所有荷載與風險降為三分之一。

Setting unobserved pre-installation movement to zero can overstate support participation and misplace the intersection.
Dividing a section into three parts reduces every load and risk to one third.

steps.title: 分部面積與暴露尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Subdivided area and exposure scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分部面積與暴露尺度」如何影響隧道分部開挖與支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Subdivided area and exposure scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sequential excavation and support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分割斷面改變同時暴露的面積與形狀，卻也新增接縫和施工介面。面積減少可能有利於控制某些局部機制，但總斷面與暫時支護仍需共同受力，不能將面積比例直接當作穩定度比例。 假設總斷面80 m²分為30、30、20 m²三部分，最大單部面積30/80=37.5%；每次假設進尺1 m時，最大單部原位開挖30 m³。 相鄰開挖面時間重疊而未更新模型，會形成比圖面預想更大的開放區；局部掉塊或變形增加可能被錯認為偶發材料問題，實際原因卻是施工序列偏離。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分部面積與暴露尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Subdivision changes simultaneously exposed area and shape while creating joints and construction interfaces. A smaller face can help control some local mechanisms, but the complete section and temporary supports still interact. Area ratios cannot directly represent stability ratios. Assume an 80 m² section divided into 30, 30 and 20 m² parts. The largest part is 30/80=37.5%; at an assumed 1 m increment its in-situ excavation is 30 m³. Overlapping adjacent excavations without updating the model creates a larger open region than planned. Increased movement or local falls may then be misclassified as isolated material problems when the underlying issue is a departure from the intended sequence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Subdivided area and exposure scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把斷面分成三塊就能把所有荷載與風險降為三分之一。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dividing a section into three parts reduces every load and risk to one third." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分部面積與暴露尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Subdivided area and exposure scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分部面積與暴露尺度
knowledge.text: 分割斷面改變同時暴露的面積與形狀，卻也新增接縫和施工介面。面積減少可能有利於控制某些局部機制，但總斷面與暫時支護仍需共同受力，不能將面積比例直接當作穩定度比例。
knowledge.textEn: Subdivision changes simultaneously exposed area and shape while creating joints and construction interfaces. A smaller face can help control some local mechanisms, but the complete section and temporary supports still interact.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：把斷面分成三塊就能把所有荷載與風險降為三分之一。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「分部面積與暴露尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

分割斷面改變同時暴露的面積與形狀，卻也新增接縫和施工介面。
optionsEn: Dividing a section into three parts reduces every load and risk to one third.
Acceptable final material strength proves that every earlier loading stage was acceptable.
Subdivision changes simultaneously exposed area and shape while creating joints and construction interfaces.

steps.title: 分部面積與暴露尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Subdivided area and exposure scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分部面積與暴露尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Subdivided area and exposure scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總斷面80 m²分為30、30、20 m²三部分，最大單部面積30/80=37.5%；每次假設進尺1 m時，最大單部原位開挖30 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume an 80 m² section divided into 30, 30 and 20 m² parts. The largest part is 30/80=37.5%; at an assumed 1 m increment its in-situ excavation is 30 m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將實際輪廓和階段記錄重疊，核對有無相鄰部分提前開放而使合併暴露面積變大；地質面誌與暫時支護狀態需同時保存，面積計算只用於幾何核對，穩定判讀由設計者另行完成。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Overlay surveyed profiles and stage records to check whether adjacent parts opened early and enlarged the combined exposure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總斷面80 m²分為30、30、20 m²三部分，最大單部面積30/80=37.5%；每次假設進尺1 m時，最大單部原位開挖30 m³。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分部面積與暴露尺度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Subdivided area and exposure scale", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
仰拱外形接起來就代表完整承載能力立即形成。
曲線擬合出有限極限值就能證明隧道已穩定。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Connecting the visible invert geometry means that full structural capacity is immediately available.
A fitted finite asymptote proves that the tunnel has reached a stable condition.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分部面積與暴露尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Subdivided area and exposure scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分部面積與暴露尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Subdivided area and exposure scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將實際輪廓和階段記錄重疊，核對有無相鄰部分提前開放而使合併暴露面積變大；地質面誌與暫時支護狀態需同時保存，面積計算只用於幾何核對，穩定判讀由設計者另行完成。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Overlay surveyed profiles and stage records to check whether adjacent parts opened early and enlarged the combined exposure. Preserve geological logs and temporary-support status together. Use area calculations for geometric reconciliation; the designer separately evaluates stability and interaction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每日圖面同時標出已開挖、已支護和已閉合區，不只標累計進尺；任何部分重疊或順序調整，都須由現場技術負責人送設計審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Daily drawings distinguish excavated, supported and closed regions instead of showing accumulated advance alone. Any overlap or sequence change is referred by the site technical lead for design review.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：相鄰開挖面時間重疊而未更新模型，會形成比圖面預想更大的開放區；局部掉塊或變形增加可能被錯認為偶發材料問題，實際原因卻是施工序列偏離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overlapping adjacent excavations without updating the model creates a larger open region than planned. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 說明「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」如何影響隧道分部開挖與支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 非圓斷面或不均勻荷載會使襯砌同時受壓與彎曲，厚度局部減少對彎曲應力的影響大於對平均壓應力的影響。線彈性截面分析只在未裂與適用材料假設下成立，需與真實受力機制分開。 假設每米寬N=200 kN、M=10 kN·m、t=0.25 m，σ=N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa，兩緣為1.76與-0.16 MPa，負值表示拉應力。 局部薄區在彎矩作用下先裂，原有內力分配可能重新調整；只看截面平均壓縮會忽略拉側與接縫開口，進而低估滲水和後續耐久風險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Noncircular geometry and uneven loads produce compression and bending together. Local thinning affects bending stress more strongly than mean compression. Linear-elastic section analysis applies only under its uncracked material assumptions and must be separated from the full ground-lining mechanism. For a 1 m strip assume N=200 kN, M=10 kN·m and t=0.25 m. Stress is N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa: edges are 1.76 and -0.16 MPa, with negative indicating tension. A thin zone may crack first under bending and redistribute internal forces. Looking only at mean compression overlooks the tensile edge and joint opening, potentially understating leakage and subsequent durability concerns. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Weak sections and eccentric bending” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均應力是壓縮就表示襯砌每個位置都沒有拉裂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Weak sections and eccentric bending”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 薄弱截面與偏心彎曲
knowledge.text: 非圓斷面或不均勻荷載會使襯砌同時受壓與彎曲，厚度局部減少對彎曲應力的影響大於對平均壓應力的影響。線彈性截面分析只在未裂與適用材料假設下成立，需與真實受力機制分開。
knowledge.textEn: Noncircular geometry and uneven loads produce compression and bending together. Local thinning affects bending stress more strongly than mean compression.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均應力是壓縮就表示襯砌每個位置都沒有拉裂。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 薄弱截面與偏心彎曲：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Weak sections and eccentric bending: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Weak sections and eccentric bending” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設每米寬N=200 kN、M=10 kN·m、t=0.25 m，σ=N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa，兩緣為1.76與-0.16 MPa，負值表示拉應力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. For a 1 m strip assume N=200 kN, M=10 kN·m and t=0.25 m. Stress is N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa: edges are 1.76 and -0.16 MPa, with negative indicating tension. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用厚度檢測與幾何掃描定位不利截面，應變計資料需校正溫度和齡期後才可換算內力；若彈性模型出現拉應力，應檢討裂縫與殘餘承載模型，不把負值直接截為零再宣稱通過。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use thickness measurements and geometry scans to locate adverse sections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

options: 曲線擬合出有限極限值就能證明隧道已穩定。
模型曲線完全吻合量測就代表所有參數都是真值。

An exact fit to measured movement means that every fitted parameter is its true value.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.

steps.title: 薄弱截面與偏心彎曲：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 用厚度檢測與幾何掃描定位不利截面，應變計資料需校正溫度和齡期後才可換算內力；若彈性模型出現拉應力，應檢討裂縫與殘餘承載模型，不把負值直接截為零再宣稱通過。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use thickness measurements and geometry scans to locate adverse sections. Correct strain records for temperature and age before inferring forces. If elastic analysis predicts tension, review cracking and residual resistance rather than clipping negative stress to zero and declaring success. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Report axial force, moment and both edge stresses separately, preserving the sign convention. When cracking is possible, the designer determines further verification and modeling; a mean value cannot close acceptance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部薄區在彎矩作用下先裂，原有內力分配可能重新調整；只看截面平均壓縮會忽略拉側與接縫開口，進而低估滲水和後續耐久風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A thin zone may crack first under bending and redistribute internal forces. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

If elastic analysis predicts tension, review cracking and residual resistance rather than clipping negative stress to zero and declaring success.

quiz.question: 要驗證「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Weak sections and eccentric bending"?

quiz.explanationEn: Use thickness measurements and geometry scans to locate adverse sections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 薄弱截面與偏心彎曲：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Weak sections and eccentric bending: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Weak sections and eccentric bending” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部薄區在彎矩作用下先裂，原有內力分配可能重新調整；只看截面平均壓縮會忽略拉側與接縫開口，進而低估滲水和後續耐久風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A thin zone may crack first under bending and redistribute internal forces. Looking only at mean compression overlooks the tensile edge and joint opening, potentially understating leakage and subsequent durability concerns. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Invert closure and stiffness change" and "Construction timing and stiffness compatibility": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 仰拱閉合與剛度改變：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Invert closure and stiffness change: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「仰拱閉合與剛度改變」如何影響隧道分部開挖與支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Invert closure and stiffness change” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sequential excavation and support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 開口支護和閉合環的力流不同，仰拱接通後可增加環向約束，但接縫柔度與地層接觸仍影響實際剛度。用等效彈簧比較只展示閉合改變，不聲稱結構一定立即成為完整圓環。 假設同一增量荷載ΔF=600 kN，開口等效剛度20 kN/mm、閉合後60 kN/mm，位移增量分別30與10 mm；兩剛度均為教學假設。 圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「仰拱閉合與剛度改變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Open support and a closed ring have different load paths. Invert connection can add circumferential restraint, but joint compliance and ground contact still govern effective stiffness. Equivalent springs illustrate the change without claiming that closure instantly creates a perfect circular ring. Assume the same incremental force ΔF=600 kN. With equivalent stiffness 20 kN/mm before closure and 60 kN/mm after, displacement increments are 30 and 10 mm; both stiffnesses are teaching assumptions. A geometrically closed section with ineffective joints can be less stiff than assumed. Removing temporary members on that assumption may restart movement, demonstrating that geometric closure and effective structural closure are different conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Invert closure and stiffness change” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 仰拱閉合與剛度改變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Invert closure and stiffness change: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「仰拱閉合與剛度改變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Invert closure and stiffness change” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設同一增量荷載ΔF=600 kN，開口等效剛度20 kN/mm、閉合後60 kN/mm，位移增量分別30與10 mm；兩剛度均為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume the same incremental force ΔF=600 kN. With equivalent stiffness 20 kN/mm before closure and 60 kN/mm after, displacement increments are 30 and 10 mm; both stiffnesses are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對仰拱幾何、連接完成時間與材料齡期，將閉合前後收斂增量按相同施工事件比較；排除荷載變小或基準重設的影響，才討論剛度改變，任何等效值都須附上識別資料和不確定度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check invert geometry, connection completion and material age.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Invert closure and stiffness change", which statement holds?

steps.title: 仰拱閉合與剛度改變：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Invert closure and stiffness change: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「仰拱閉合與剛度改變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Invert closure and stiffness change” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對仰拱幾何、連接完成時間與材料齡期，將閉合前後收斂增量按相同施工事件比較；排除荷載變小或基準重設的影響，才討論剛度改變，任何等效值都須附上識別資料和不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check invert geometry, connection completion and material age. Compare convergence increments around matching construction events before and after closure. Exclude reduced loading or reset references before attributing changes to stiffness; every inferred equivalent value needs supporting data and uncertainty. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.titleEn: Invert closure and stiffness change: failure diagnosis

steps.instruction: 圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A geometrically closed section with ineffective joints can be less stiff than assumed. Removing temporary members on that assumption may restart movement, demonstrating that geometric closure and effective structural closure are different conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Removing temporary members on that assumption may restart movement, demonstrating that geometric closure and effective structural closure are different conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「仰拱外形接起來就代表完整承載能力立即形成。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Connecting the visible invert geometry means that full structural capacity is immediately available." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「仰拱閉合與剛度改變」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Invert closure and stiffness change" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
量到的所有應變乘最終彈性模數就是當下內力。
圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
All measured strain multiplied by the final elastic modulus gives the current internal force.
A geometrically closed section with ineffective joints can be less stiff than assumed.
quiz.explanation: 圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A geometrically closed section with ineffective joints can be less stiff than assumed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 施工時間與剛度相容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Construction timing and stiffness compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工時間與剛度相容」如何影響隧道分部開挖與支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Construction timing and stiffness compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sequential excavation and support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相同軸力作用於不同齡期材料會產生不同彈性應變，而早齡徐變使單純彈性關係更受限制。施工時間表不只是管理資料，它決定各部分材料在荷載轉移時的剛度以及可能的內力再分配。 假設單位寬A=0.25 m²、N=300 kN，E=6 GPa時ε=N/(EA)=200微應變；E=12 GPa時為100微應變，未包含徐變與收縮。 較晚啟用的儀器漏記先期應變，與年輕材料的低剛度疊加後可能誤判荷載很小；若再忽略徐變，內力估計的方向甚至可能和真實變化不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工時間與剛度相容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Equal axial force produces different elastic strain in materials of different age, while early creep further limits a purely elastic relation. The construction timetable is therefore a mechanical input: it determines stiffness during load transfer and potential redistribution among components. Assume unit-width area A=0.25 m² and N=300 kN. At E=6 GPa, ε=N/(EA)=200 microstrain; at E=12 GPa it is 100 microstrain, excluding creep and shrinkage. Late gauge activation misses earlier strain and, combined with low young-material stiffness, can suggest falsely small loading. Ignoring creep adds further bias and may make the inferred force trend differ from the actual load-transfer history. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Construction timing and stiffness compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量到的所有應變乘最終彈性模數就是當下內力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All measured strain multiplied by the final elastic modulus gives the current internal force." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工時間與剛度相容」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Construction timing and stiffness compatibility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Equal axial force produces different elastic strain in materials of different age, while early creep further limits a purely elastic relation. The construction timetable is therefore a mechanical input: it determines stiffness during load transfer and potential redistribution among components.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量到的所有應變乘最終彈性模數就是當下內力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All measured strain multiplied by the final elastic modulus gives the current internal force. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工時間與剛度相容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Construction timing and stiffness compatibility" is correct?
options: 相同軸力作用於不同齡期材料會產生不同彈性應變，而早齡徐變使單純彈性關係更受限制。

曲線擬合出有限極限值就能證明隧道已穩定。

quiz.question: 依「施工時間與剛度相容」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 施工時間與剛度相容：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Construction timing and stiffness compatibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工時間與剛度相容」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Construction timing and stiffness compatibility” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄噴築時間、環境溫度、材料試驗與應變計啟用時刻，核對零點是否在已受力後才設定；將彈性、溫度和時間效應分別列出，無足夠證據時不能把全部應變都換算成結構軸力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize placement time, temperature, material tests and strain-gauge activation. Determine whether zero was established after loading had already begun. Separate elastic, thermal and time-dependent components; insufficient evidence precludes converting all measured strain directly into structural axial force. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：資料交接附上儀器零點時刻及材料齡期對照表，不能補填不存在的初始讀值；模型採用的剛度與時間效應由材料、監測和設計人員共同確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover includes gauge-zero times and material-age tables without inventing missing initial readings. Material, monitoring and design specialists jointly confirm the stiffness and time effects adopted in the model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：較晚啟用的儀器漏記先期應變，與年輕材料的低剛度疊加後可能誤判荷載很小；若再忽略徐變，內力估計的方向甚至可能和真實變化不同。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Late gauge activation misses earlier strain and, combined with low young-material stiffness, can suggest falsely small loading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工時間與剛度相容」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 施工時間與剛度相容：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Construction timing and stiffness compatibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工時間與剛度相容」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Construction timing and stiffness compatibility” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 較晚啟用的儀器漏記先期應變，與年輕材料的低剛度疊加後可能誤判荷載很小；若再忽略徐變，內力估計的方向甚至可能和真實變化不同。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Late gauge activation misses earlier strain and, combined with low young-material stiffness, can suggest falsely small loading. Ignoring creep adds further bias and may make the inferred force trend differ from the actual load-transfer history. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：較晚啟用的儀器漏記先期應變，與年輕材料的低剛度疊加後可能誤判荷載很小；若再忽略徐變，內力估計的方向甚至可能和真實變化不同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring creep adds further bias and may make the inferred force trend differ from the actual load-transfer history.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量到的所有應變乘最終彈性模數就是當下內力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All measured strain multiplied by the final elastic modulus gives the current internal force." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「收斂曲線與外推界線」與「防水介面與壓力分布」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Convergence curves and extrapolation limits" and "Waterproofing interfaces and pressure distribution": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 收斂曲線與外推界線：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Convergence curves and extrapolation limits: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「收斂曲線與外推界線」如何影響隧道分部開挖與支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Convergence curves and extrapolation limits” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sequential excavation and support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 指數曲線可以摘要逐漸變慢的合成收斂，但擬合形式不會自動證明地層穩定。開挖距離、地下水和後續拆除都可能改變邊界，造成原先衰減的曲線重新加速，預測必須附帶情境。 假設u(t)=20[1-exp(-t/5)] mm，t以day計，u(5)=12.64 mm、u(10)=17.29 mm；極限20 mm只是模型參數，非現場允收限值。 將加速讀值當作離群點刪除，會讓擬合曲線看似穩定卻失去預警能力；當邊界已改變，延用舊極限值可能錯估後續變形與需要的審查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「收斂曲線與外推界線」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An exponential curve can summarize synthetic convergence that slows with time, but its fitted form does not prove stability. Excavation distance, groundwater and later removals can change boundaries and restart acceleration. A forecast must therefore state the scenario under which it applies. Assume u(t)=20[1-exp(-t/5)] mm with t in days. Values are u(5)=12.64 mm and u(10)=17.29 mm; the 20 mm asymptote is a model parameter, not a field acceptance limit. Deleting accelerating readings as outliers can make a fitted curve look stable while removing its warning value. After boundaries change, retaining the old asymptote may misrepresent future movement and the need for engineering review. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Convergence curves and extrapolation limits” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「曲線擬合出有限極限值就能證明隧道已穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fitted finite asymptote proves that the tunnel has reached a stable condition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「收斂曲線與外推界線」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.question: 關於「收斂曲線與外推界線」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 曲線擬合出有限極限值就能證明隧道已穩定。

steps.title: 收斂曲線與外推界線：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Convergence curves and extrapolation limits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「收斂曲線與外推界線」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Convergence curves and extrapolation limits” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u(t)=20[1-exp(-t/5)] mm，t以day計，u(5)=12.64 mm、u(10)=17.29 mm；極限20 mm只是模型參數，非現場允收限值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume u(t)=20[1-exp(-t/5)] mm with t in days. Values are u(5)=12.64 mm and u(10)=17.29 mm; the 20 mm asymptote is a model parameter, not a field acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用保留的後期資料而非同一擬合樣本檢查預測誤差，將開挖和支護事件標在時間軸上；若殘差有系統性趨勢，應重新審查模型邊界，不能只增加曲線平滑程度讓異常看起來消失。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test predictions on withheld later observations rather than only the fitting sample.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「收斂曲線與外推界線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 用保留的後期資料而非同一擬合樣本檢查預測誤差，將開挖和支護事件標在時間軸上；若殘差有系統性趨勢，應重新審查模型邊界，不能只增加曲線平滑程度讓異常看起來消失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
